On August 2, 1971, American Apollo 15 mission commander David Scott placed a poignant memorial on the surface of the moon. Designed by Belgian artist Paul von Hoeydonck the memorial, titled Fallen Astronaut, comprised an aluminium statuette depicting a space-suited astronaut and a small plaque bearing the names of 14 astronauts and cosmonauts who had died in the line of duty.
